$description: Signal Kit design tokens. Source of truth for web/signal.css and ios/Sources/SignalKit/SignalTheme.swift.

ink-2.use: stripe highlight in the stripe field

ink-3.use: raised ink: tab bar edge, dark pill, radar rings

sage.use: main slab, outer pill band (poster label #bab9ad)

sage-hi.use: inner pill, raised tiles, outline X on ink

sage-lo.use: pressed, dividers on sage, toggle track

coral.use: the only accent: diagonal band, primary action, alerts, active state

japanese.use: vertical captions, hanko seals, outlined kanji

french.use: italic asides, dates, taglines, pull quotes

rules: One coral surface per screen: the diagonal band, a primary button, or an alert sheet.
Ink top and sage bottom, split along a diagonal. Light screens are allowed (all sage), but stripes stay ink.
Rounded forms are stadiums, circles and the rounded X only. Rectangles stay square or chamfered, never a generic corner radius.
Mono telemetry is right-aligned to the gutter. Wordmarks are uppercase Archivo Expanded Black.
Decorative numbers and codes (09, #hex, sp c53) should be real values from the app wherever possible.
Language: English runs the interface. Japanese adds texture, at most one moment per screen. French is the italic aside, at most one per screen. All three stacked only once per app.
